description: Private four-message SHA-512-family component over existing clearing AVX2 batch kernels; ordinary native Linux and local Windows processes, not an enclave resident or supported host API.

checks: SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA-512/224, SHA-512/256 and every valid general-t parameter
Independent bit oracle, byte-aligned hashlib cross-checks, partial bits and lane isolation
Required vector work, no common group rejection, bounds and canonical tails
Budget exhaustion, exact sequences, terminal phases and retained-plan binding
Copy failures, revocation, recoverable unwind, retained-output clearing and reuse
Send/Sync/Copy/Clone/Debug and escaping borrowed authority rejected

source_binding.windows_checkout: ee9c1138 plus the three component source/test files; source-bound overlay, not a clean exact Git checkout

test_runner_notes: Shared runtime oracle loop avoids separately optimizing hundreds of identical harness bodies without dropping cases
Each compiled mutation has a unique preserved executable; a Windows LNK1104 on an earlier overwritten executable failed that campaign and is not counted as a pass
Source hashes are rechecked at completion; clean source is rebuilt and rerun after mutations
limitations: Public synthetic inputs and author checks, not independent review
Private component has no protected-page resident, OS-copy protocol or supported host constructor yet
No current-image stack/register/spill/dump qualification; enclosing owner and all execution frames still require protected integration
No Miri, sanitizer, AVX-512, dedicated SHA512 instruction, multicore or Windows ARM64 qualification in this campaign
No production signing or release-readiness claim; existing gates unchanged
